apps.name: Feather
apps.localizedDescription: Feather is a free on-device iOS application manager/installer built with UIKit for quality.
apps.subtitle: On-device signing application

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's New
- **Home Screen widget**: shows available updates with fanned app icons, checks in the background and follows the app tint
- **On-device certificate authority** replaces backloop.dev for local installs, with a first-launch guide to trusting it
- Onboarding can be reset from the Reset page
- Signing, download and install progress shown as a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
- Download progress split into downloading and extracting
- Signing progress shown on the sign button
- Export and import the database
- App info shows where an app came from
- Warn before adding apps that don't match their source or device
- Ask once before replacing older versions of an app
- Alert when an OTA install stalls or fails
- Feather updates itself after every other app, and can optionally be removed from the library afterwards
- Make an idevice pairing file from the Remote CLI and send it to the device
- Reject certificates whose p12 isn't in the provisioning profile

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed certificates being rejected with a wrong password error after Feather imported its own signing certificate
- Fixed the certificate setup guide being skipped when Feather was launched in the background after an update
- Compression level picked in settings is now used when archiving
- Get, Open and Update buttons share one width in Sources
- Modify chevron matches the system one
- Alternate app icons declared for iPad, and icon change errors are shown
- Real RSD tunnel error is shown and recovers after a failure
- WWDR G2–G8 issuers supported in the revoke check
- Korean wording: 더 보기 and 확인; 소스 renamed to 저장소

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/seomin0610/Feather/compare/v2.9.3...v2.9.4

## What's New
- **Remote CLI**: import, sign, install and export apps from a computer
- Signing, installing and remote imports shown in the Dynamic Island
- Remote imports and signing progress shown on the device
- Open / Update buttons on store listings for installed apps
- Apps are replaced on update by default
- Markdown rendering in release notes
- Display the app's minimum iOS version before signing (#721)
- Entitlement merging (#723)
- Complete Korean translations

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed wildcard iCloud services entitlement
- Properties is grayed out while signing
- Background audio keeps running until every holder stops it
- Install work folder is deleted once the install is done
- Library progress bar stays visible for the whole remote import
- Fixed typo in Reset Sources alert title (#718)
- Fixed Zsign build (#717)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/seomin0610/Feather/compare/v2.9.2...v2.9.3

news.title: About Feather
news.caption:
Feather allows you to use an Apple Developer Account to sign and install applications on device without needing a computer on stock iOS versions, while allowing easy management with its applications.

Due to limitations, it's hard to tell if the application is actually installed, so you will need to keep track of whats on your device. This is an entirely stock application and uses built-in features to be able to do this!
